detail.longDescription: Over the last 4 to 5 years, Greece has embraced the digitization of bureaucracy. Still, most of their websites looking like a sketchy 2000's retro forum trying to scam unsuspecting kids into buying counter strike cheats. I'm sure that even their database must be a horrible stack of unsecure patches thrown on top of a structure that's still standing on rotten wooden pillars. Come on Greek system, don't apply security patches the same way you patch potholes on our streets. Playing around with digital security now too? Cause if we speak about our physical one, you already sacrificed it on the altar of corruption. # System # Greece # Greek # CyberSecurity # Security # Privacy # Politics # Corruption # Websites # Government # Research # Pentesting
